title: Austin Leaders Join Chamber Luncheon
summary:
*   Austin's elected officials attended the annual Greater Austin Chamber of Commerce Luncheon.
*   The gathering served as an opportunity for networking and discussions with the local business community.
*   No formal city business was conducted, and no policy decisions were made during this event.
